title: Preview a file using QuickLook from the terminal
summary: Use the command line to open the QuickLook preview window for a file, just like pressing the Spacebar in Finder. This is useful for quickly checking file contents without opening the full application.

steps.explain: Run qlmanage with the -p flag followed by the path to the file you want to preview. This opens the QuickLook window.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to preview
